# First customers — acme-cli

> Generated by traction-doctor v0.5.0 on 2026-09-25 (web research on)
> for the wedge in STRATEGY.md: Rust teams on edge runtimes.
> **Private working file.** It lists strangers' public posts. Keep it out of
> git — add `FIRST-CUSTOMERS*.md` to `.gitignore` — and never share it.
> SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE: every venue and post here is fictional.

## Who you're looking for

- **The person:** a developer on a 2–10 person Rust team shipping to an edge runtime
- **The moment they need you:** a deploy fails because the hosted control plane is down or unreachable
- **Not a fit:** teams happy on a hosted platform's one-command deploy

## The offer

A 20-minute call where I set acme-cli up on your repo. It costs you the 20
minutes; I ask for honest feedback and a re-try in week 4.

## Message drafts

### Public reply

> If the problem is [their words], the usual fix is to bundle the build and
> the config into one artifact you can push over any link. I built
> acme-cli to do that offline — happy to set it up on your repo in a
> 20-minute call if useful.

**Personalize:** echo their setup (ship, air-gapped CI, flaky uplink).

### Issue comment

> +1 on an offline mode. In the meantime: a local bundle step plus a signed
> push gets you most of the way. I maintain acme-cli, which does this end to
> end; glad to help wire it in here.

**Personalize:** name the issue's runtime and the release step it mentions.

## First 14 days

- **Day 1:** send to openings 1–3
- **Days 2–5:** run the forum and Q&A searches for new openings, at most 5 messages a day
- **Day 7:** count replies; rewrite the draft that isn't landing
- **Day 14:** count replies and tries; apply the stop signal

## Rules

- One message per person. If they don't reply, let it go — no follow-ups.
- Reply only where they posted; send a direct message only where the venue
  allows it and the person invited help.
- Say you built it, every time.
- Read each venue's rule before posting, and follow karma minimums and
  megathreads.
- Never look up anyone's email, real name, or other accounts.
- At most 5 new messages a day, so each one is personal.
- **Stop signal:** weekly installs < 100 by 2026-12-31 (section 9) — then run Pivot A's test.
